因而，算力的发展已成为全社会所关注的话题: As a result, the development of computing power has become a topic of concern across society.
《大国算力：重塑未来的中国力量》由工作在算力发展第一线的专家们共同撰写，从历史与: "Great Power Computing Power: The Chinese Force Reshaping the Future" has been co-authored by experts working at the forefront of computing power development. It traces the development trajectory of computing power from both historical and contemporary dimensions, and also examines its position in today's technological and industrial landscape.
